preconditions.description: The number of pastures n and paths m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= w <= 10**9 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct pastures within the valid range and has a positive integer weight.
The input contains exactly m edges.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines, one for each prefix of edges.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == -1) or (output_lines[i] == min(max(w for u, v, w in subset) for subset in valid_sunny_subsets(i))) for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: For each i, if a sunny paving exists using a subset of the first i edges, the output is the minimum possible maximum edge weight among all such valid subsets; otherwise, it is -1. A subset is valid if every vertex has an odd degree in the subgraph formed by that subset.
